    cols = len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    path = []

    def find_path(row, col):

        return {}

def perfect_maze(h: int, w: int, rng: random.Random) -> list[str]:
    """DFS-generated perfect maze on an h x w grid (odd h, w): cells at even coordinates."""

        r, c = stack[-1]
